bio:
Peter Kaufmann

*Monthly*



“Obsessive” is as good a word as any to describe Peter Kaufmann’s love affair with underground dance music and vinyl culture. A dedicated record digger and selector, he’s spent countless hours combing through physical and virtual crates in search of rare gems, forgotten obscurities, and timeless tracks that can still forge an immediate connection with the dancefloor.

Genre and era are secondary in Kaufmann’s selections. Golden-era tech house, woozy breakbeat, colorful progressive, low-slung deep house, and many other shades of dance music can all find their way into the mix. Based in Washington, DC, he’s played at renowned venues in cities like DC, New York, and LA, featuring at parties like Pittsburgh’s Hot Mass and Los Angeles’ Visions. In his 15+ years behind the decks, he’s shared bills with selectors including The Ghost, Francesco Del Garda, Nicolas Lutz, Gene On Earth, KRN, and many others.


Despite a relatively low profile, Kaufmann’s approach is anything but anonymous. Years spent digging, listening, and refining his taste have produced a sound that’s distinctly his own—one rooted less in genre convention than in the simple pursuit of a great record and the moment it creates on the dancefloor.
title: Peter Kaufmann
